content:
We are now just one day away from Apple's "Scary Fast" event, which is expected to showcase between six and nine new products.

The iPhone Ultra foldable will be the headline news, but out of all the expected announcements, which one are you personally most excited about...?

At a minimum, we expect Apple to announce six new products tomorrow, but if all the rumors pan out, there could be as many as nine.

The iPhone Ultra will almost certainly be the media's focal point. It is Apple's first-ever foldable iPhone, arriving about seven years after Samsung pioneered the form factor. However, with an expected price tag of over $2,000, and possibly up to $3,000 for the highest-spec configurations, it's definitely not going to be the best-selling product.

So out of all the expected and possible announcements, which one are you personally most excited about? After watching our video rundown, make sure to take part in our poll, and share your thoughts in the comments section.
